name: Pamela Starlson
office: Lancaster School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Pamela Starlson is the Area 5 incumbent on the Lancaster School District Governing Board, elected in 2022. She was a district parent advocate from 2003 to 2012. She holds degrees in sociology, criminal justice, and liberal arts and sciences, and has worked as an at-risk youth counselor and in student services.

items.text: As a board member, she has participated in CSBA professional development workshops and training sessions. In a 2026 candidate questionnaire, she said the board’s primary responsibility is to provide governance, set policy, and ensure the district moves in the right direction.
